stemMd: Which function need not be specified by the proposed connector standard?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The existence of a shared attachment specification.

options.label: B
options.textMd: How devices physically attach at the interface.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Every procedure for joining compatible devices.

options.label: D
options.textMd: How a sensor measures its signal.

explanationMd: The analyst explicitly separates attachment rules from internal sensing and processing functions.

distractorRationale.b: Attachment is what the connector specification covers.
distractorRationale.e: Those belong to the standard’s interface boundary.
distractorRationale.c: The passage does not exempt all joining procedures.
